authority_boundary: Inference edges and combination candidates are generated candidate evidence. They are deterministic structural signals, not proof of value. A human or the combination review queue promotes; nothing here promotes itself. No percentage or confidence value is emitted until a family has at least min_reviewed_for_percentages labeled combinations.

workflow_stages.description: Closed, ordered vocabulary of the stages an asset acts in. Adjacency is defined by position in this list. Do not add stages without review; renumbering changes every complements edge.

artifact_kinds.description: Closed vocabulary for produces/consumes facets. A produces->consumes match on a shared kind is the atom of a workflow chain.

rules.description: Two assets complement when they share task context and cover adjacent but disjoint workflow stages, so together they cover more of a task than either alone.
preconditions: both assets declare at least one workflow_stage
the two assets' workflow_stage sets are disjoint (no shared stage)
the minimum absolute distance between any stage of A and any stage of B in the ordered stage list equals 1 (strictly adjacent)
the assets share at least min_shared_task_tokens task_type tokens
rules.danger_if_wrong: False complements pollute combination discovery and waste review time.

rules.description: Two assets complement when both are evidenced against the same DAD need through different capabilities, covering that need from two angles. Reserved for v0.2; not emitted by the v0.1 engine.
preconditions: both assets link to the same need id (via lesson gap_evidence_for or declared need coverage)
the capability token sets the two assets contribute to that need are not identical
rules.danger_if_wrong: Research and build effort can be misdirected toward redundant coverage.

rules.description: Two assets are co-used when the usage ledger shows both used or watched in the same repo. Strength is the count of DISTINCT repos, never a percentage.
preconditions: both assets have a usage row (status using or watching) for the same repo
rules.danger_if_wrong: DAD can spam bundled recommendations based on accidental co-use.

rules.description: A workflow combination is a directed chain A->B->C where each asset produces an artifact_kind the next asset consumes. Chains of at least min_chain_length distinct assets become a combination_candidate hypernode; members attach via member_of edges. This is the strongest whole-workflow signal because the handoff artifact is explicit.
preconditions: a directed edge A->B exists iff A.produces intersect B.consumes is non-empty
the chain is a simple path (no repeated asset) of length >= min_chain_length
chain length is capped at max_chain_length to bound enumeration
rules.danger_if_wrong: Workflow recommendations can bundle unrelated assets into a false pipeline.

rules.description: A secondary combination signal: a set of at least min_chain_length assets that share a task_type token and whose combined workflow_stages cover a contiguous run of at least min_contiguous_stages stages. Weaker than produces/consumes chaining; used when handoff artifacts are not declared. Reserved for v0.2; not emitted by the v0.1 engine.
preconditions: assets share at least one task_type token pairwise-connected through the group
the union of the group's workflow_stages forms a contiguous run of length >= min_contiguous_stages in the ordered stage list
rules.danger_if_wrong: Stage coverage without an artifact handoff can group assets that never actually feed each other.

output_labels.note: New combinations start hypothesized. Only the review queue moves them. Rejected combinations are kept as negative evidence so the same pair is not re-proposed as novel.

determinism: All rules use set membership, integer counts, and ordered-list index arithmetic only. No randomness, no floats-as-truth, no wall-clock input. Same registries + usage ledger produce a byte-identical candidate set after sorting.
